changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO input_event_types (kind, type, description, example_payload) VALUES ('control', 'drop', 'Connect Four — drop a disc into a column (host re-applies via c4_apply_drop).', '{"col":3}'::jsonb), ('control', 'claim', 'Dots and Boxes — claim an edge by index (host re-applies via the boxes engine).', '{"edge":0}'::jsonb), ('control', 'reset', 'New-game request the host re-applies to its engine (connect-four / dots-and-boxes reset).', '{"reset":true}'::jsonb), ('control', 'fire', 'Battleship — fire at a board coordinate (host resolves via battleship_resolve).', '{"coord":"B7"}'::jsonb), ('control', 'ready', 'Battleship — a player has finished placement and is ready (host advances phase).', '{"ready":true}'::jsonb), ('control', 'dir', 'Tron — queue a heading change for a light-cycle (host applies on the next tick).', '{"player":1,"dir":"up"}'::jsonb), ('control', 'input', 'Asteroids Duel — per-frame thrust/turn/fire input vector (host applies to its tick loop).', '{"player":1,"thrust":true,"turn":0,"fire":false}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (kind, type) DO NOTHING;
